item.title: Virginia lawmakers fail to reach budget agreement due to data center dispute
item.description: Virginia lawmakers have failed to reach a budget agreement as of Thursday, meaning it's possible they won't be able to pass one at all before the current General Assembly session ends.

item.title: Hopewell woman accused of hitting juvenile with car on Halloween while intoxicated
item.description: A Hopewell woman is accused of hitting a juvenile with her car on Halloween while intoxicated, according to Colonial Heights Police.

item.title: Students 'render gunman no longer alive' after campus shooting that killed 1, injured 2
item.description: Mohamed Jalloh, a man previously convicted of providing ISIL material support and released from prison in 2024, has been identified as the shooter at Old Dominion University Thursday morning. One person was killed and two others hurt in the shooting.

item.title: 'I was emotionally numb': Virginia recovery academy student's story of overcoming addiction
item.description: Lexie was in middle school when she started smoking marijuana. Now, she's a high school junior on a sobriety journey alongside a dozen other students.

item.title: 'Dream again': Formerly incarcerated man turned entrepreneur delivers message of hope to Henrico inmates
item.description: A man who spent a decade behind bars in Virginia has turned that struggle into purpose, becoming an entrepreneur using an innovative design he crafted while incarcerated.

item.title: Richmond community mourns beloved VCU Dining greeter 'Miss Peaches'
item.description: The Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) community is mourning after the death of Jackie "Miss Peaches" Cherry, who served as a greeter at the university's Shafer Dining Hall.

item.title: PHOTOS: Snowfall surprises Central Virginia after warm weather
item.description: An unusual and wacky snowfall swept through Central Virginia on Thursday after temperatures climbed into the 70s and even the low 80s over the last two days.

item.title: Central Virginia neighbors share concerns over proposed $1 billion transmission line project
item.description: A proposed $1 billion transmission line project that would run through parts of Central Virginia has sparked concern among residents who believe the project would negatively reshape their communities.

item.title: PHOTOS: Electric vehicle reignites at Chesterfield tow yard during snow day
item.description: Chesterfield County firefighters braved the snow to put out an electric vehicle that reignited at a tow yard Thursday afternoon.

item.title: 'Pretty wild': Central Virginians get weather whiplash as snow falls after record-high temperatures
item.description: Thursday afternoon's snow shocked some Central Virginians, as it came on the heels of several days of warm temperatures -- including record-highs in the 80s.
